description:
Join us as a Forward Deployed Software Engineer for Identity Services at Barclays, where you'll contribute to building and maintaining our next-generation identity platform that powers secure authentication and authorization across our digital banking ecosystem. This is an excellent opportunity to work with modern technologies, frameworks, and AI-assisted development tools while collaborating with talented engineers, product owners, and security specialists to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that impact millions of customers.
  
  
To be successful as a Forward Deployed Software Engineer you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Resilience, corporate communication and relationship-building skills to drive change
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools and practices to accelerate development, improve code quality, and enhance productivity
* 3+ years of software development experience with strong proficiency in modern programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, or Go, including experience building RESTful APIs and microservices
* Solid understanding of Identity and Access Management concepts including authentication , authorization, single sign-on, and identity federation
* Good understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, or Azure) and containerisation technologies (Docker)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, build automation tools (GitLab CI), and version control systems (Git)
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to write clean, maintainable, well-tested code following software engineering best practices

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Experience working with Ping Identity, or similar IAM platforms and their APIs
* Experience working with Open Policy Agent (OPA), or similar policy engines and their APIs
* Experience working with databases and developing extract-transform-load (ETL) solutions
* Knowledge of authentication protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML) and security best practices for web applications
* Experience with test-driven development (TDD), automated testing frameworks, and code quality tools
* Background in Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working in cross-functional teams
* Exposure to financial services or regulated industries with understanding of compliance and security requirements

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Pune
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

description:
**About 4flow**
4flow is a global leader in logistics optimization, with a team of over 1,500 professionals across more than 20 locations worldwide. Our unique business model integrates supply chain consulting, advanced logistics software, 4PL services, and cutting-edge logistics research to deliver innovative and end-to-end solutions.
  
  
Our Bangalore office, located in Manyata Tech Park, is one of our newest and most dynamic hubs. Here, we are building a next-generation, AI-driven supply chain product from the ground up. Operating in a hybrid work model, this location offers a unique opportunity to join the development team at an early stage and play a key role in shaping the future of our product and technology landscape.
  
  
**Job Description**
Designs, develops, and operates end-to-end software solutions across frontend and backend systems, combining deep technical expertise with a broad cross-functional understanding of product, platform, and operations. Acts as a
**T-shaped engineer**
, bringing strong specialization while contributing effectively across adjacent domains such as DevOps, security, performance, and user experience to maximize product value. This role requires close collaboration with
**globally distributed teams**
across regions and time zones to ensure alignment, consistency, and successful delivery of shared product goals.
  
  
**What your new challenge will look like**

* Design and develop front-end and back-end components within service-based architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Own the end-to-end software lifecycle, from ideation and system design to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Apply T-shaped engineering principles, contributing beyond core specialization to areas such as product understanding, UX impact, reliability, and security.
* Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies to enhance architecture, developer productivity, and product capabilities.
* Drive automation across system setup, CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and operational processes in collaboration with DevOps practices.
* Identify system bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural gaps; lead initiatives for continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, UX/UI, QA, DevOps, and Security to deliver high-quality, customer-centric solutions.
* Engage in technical discussions with global stakeholders, contributing to architecture decisions, standards, and best practices.
* Make informed technical decisions by evaluating trade-offs across engineering, product, and operational dimensions.
* Promote engineering excellence by establishing reusable patterns, frameworks, and tooling.
* Conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning.

**Why you belong at 4flow**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or related field
* 8+ years of experience in modern web applications and distributed systems
* Strong expertise in both frontend and backend (T‑shaped profile)
* Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, Next.js, PrimeVue.js
* Backend: Java 17+, Spring Boot
* Strong knowledge of modular architecture, API design, microservices
* Familiarity with Domain‑Driven Design (DDD) is a plus
* Ability to evaluate trade‑offs and deliver scalable solutions
* Working knowledge of AWS, CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies
* Experience with monitoring, logging, observability
* Understanding of security fundamentals (authentication, authorization, secure coding)
* Ability to connect technical decisions with business outcomes
* Contributions to performance optimization, DevOps, security, test automation, platform architecture
* Tools: Git, Gradle, Maven, GitLab CI/CD, Jira, Confluence
* Nice to have: SQL/NoSQL databases, Docker, Linux environments, AI/ML integrations
* ERP systems experience (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics)
* Knowledge of inventory, supply chain, order management workflows
* Experience with ERP APIs, data synchronization, interoperability
* Passion for software engineering and curiosity beyond specialization
* T‑shaped mindset with openness to learn across domains
* Strong analytical and systems‑thinking abilities
* Pragmatic decision‑making with technical depth
* Self‑driven, adaptable, thrives in fast‑paced environments
* Excellent communication and collaboration in global teams
* Builds strong cross‑cultural relationships
* Commitment to continuous learning, innovation, and engineering excellence
* Motivated to align with company values and contribute to success

**What we offer**

* A stable role within a company rooted in strong German roots, backed by a clear vision and long-term security.
* A dynamic, international work environment with excellent opportunities for rapid career growth.
* Extensive professional development support, including a dedicated training budget and access to internal learning programs.
* A permanent position with a competitive base salary, attractive bonus structure, and comprehensive benefits package.
* Hybrid work model
* Access to an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being.
* Regular sports activities, team events, and company getaways that foster connection and collaboration.
* Complimentary lunch, beverages, and coffee at all 4flow locations.
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage, including GMC, GPA, GTL, and OPD.

description:
**About Kaseya**
Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.
  
  
Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
  
  
Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
  
  
We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
  
  
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
  
  
**Staff Software Engineer, Endpoint Agent**
(Development & Automation Testing)
  
  
**Why Kaseya?**
Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated by combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively.
  
  
Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.
  
  
This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint management capabilities. The ideal candidate is passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, endpoint security, and software quality.
  
  
Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, and release confidence at scale.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.
* Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, remote actions, scripting, and device management.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Own features throughout the entire lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support.
* Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development.
* Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios.
* Improve software quality through testability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation.
* Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence.
* Reproduce complex issues across diverse operating system and endpoint environments.
* Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
* Develop integrations with operating system management, security frameworks, and device management APIs.
* Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve product supportability and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with Product, Support, Cloud Platform, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and sprint planning activities.
* Utilize AI-assisted development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality.

**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, platform services, or related applications.
* Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, including experience building production-grade applications and services.
* Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle.
* Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Selenium, Playwright or similar testing frameworks
* Experience with Windows system programming concepts such as Win32 APIs, Windows Services, WMI, Registry operations, process management, threading, security models, or related operating system capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including: Processes and threads, Filesystems, Networking, Services and daemons, Security models, Privilege management, Performance and resource utilization
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience developing software that interacts with operating system services, APIs, or management frameworks.
* Understanding of software quality engineering principles, test automation, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, code generation tools, or intelligent debugging solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, endpoint security, or device management products.
* Knowledge of C, C++, Rust, Go
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, or Linux management platforms.
* Knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, Python, AppleScript, or other scripting technologies.
* Experience building test frameworks, automation libraries, or system-level validation tooling.
* Experience working with virtualization, containerization, or automated device provisioning environments.
* Familiarity with endpoint telemetry, diagnostics, observability, and monitoring systems.

**What Success Looks Like**
A successful Senior Endpoint Software Engineer at Kaseya:
  
  

* Builds secure, scalable, and high-quality endpoint software.
* Owns features end-to-end from design through production support.
* Demonstrates strong ownership of both software development and quality.
* Develops automated validation alongside feature implementation.
* Solves complex customer, platform, and operating system challenges.
* Improves the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of endpoint agents.
* Rapidly diagnoses issues and implements long-term corrective solutions.
* Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, Platform, and Engineering teams.
* Leverages AI-native engineering practices to improve productivity and accelerate delivery.
* Continuously grows expertise in operating systems, endpoint management, systems programming, and modern software development practices.

Expect to turn broad engineering needs into technical strategy, lead initiatives that span several teams, and set standards that get adopted beyond your own pod.
  
  
You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Data, ML, and Infrastructure to balance delivery speed against reliability, security, cost, and maintainability. As Hinge Health expands its use of AI across the software development lifecycle and the care platform, you will also help make those AI and ML workloads reliable, cost efficient, and responsibly run.
  
  
The problems in this role are foundational. Fixing them makes every engineering team at Hinge Health more effective, and the software they ship helps make healthcare more accessible and affordable.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Own a multi-quarter technical roadmap for one or more Service Enablement domains, based on what internal engineering teams actually need.
* Lead architecture and design for highly available, secure, and maintainable platforms and services that cross pod boundaries.
* Build and maintain paved roads for service development, deployment, observability, reliability, and operational ownership.
* Improve developer productivity with automation, reusable frameworks, self-service workflows, and documentation that people can follow.
* Set practical standards for SLOs, alerting, incident response, capacity management, service ownership, and production readiness.
* Work with product and engineering teams to run AI and ML workloads reliably and cost efficiently, including inference systems where they make sense.
* De-risk ambiguous problems with prototypes, spikes, and experiments that produce measurable results.
* Write and lead RFCs, design reviews, and technical decision records. Explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Take part in production operations and eliminate recurring failure modes with systemic fixes.
* Deliver large initiatives from strategy through production adoption, and measure the result: platform adoption, developer productivity, reliability, cost, or reduced operational toil.
* Mentor engineers, coach senior engineers into broader technical leadership, help with hiring, and raise the bar for engineering practice across the organization.

**Hinge Health Hybrid Model**
We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.
  
  
**This is a Bengaluru-based role**
that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.
  
  

* Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).
* Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8:30 pm - 10:30pm IST).

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
* 10+ years of professional software development, or equivalent depth building and operating production systems.
* 4+ years with at least one modern programming language such as TypeScript/JavaScript,Go, Python.
* 4+ years across the full software development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations.
* 4+years of experience in cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads such as AWS, Kubernetes, or EKS.
* Experience in software design and distributed systems fundamentals: reliability, scalability, performance, failure modes, and API or platform contracts.
* Experience operating production systems, including observability, incident response, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement.
* Experience treating internal platforms and developer experience as products, with attention to usability, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, Claude etc

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building internal developer platforms, service templates, golden paths, CI/CD systems, or self-service infrastructure.
* Experience with platform security, identity and access management, compliance controls, or secure-by-default engineering.
* Experience supporting AI/ML teams with inference infrastructure, model serving platforms, evaluation workflows, or cost and performance optimization.
* Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability.
* Experience with event-driven systems, workflow orchestration, service networking, or large-scale data and messaging infrastructure.
* Experience defining platform metrics such as adoption, deployment lead time, change failure rate, availability, developer satisfaction, or operational toil.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers or acting as technical lead for a platform migration, modernization effort, or organization-wide launch.
* Experience working in healthcare, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high-trust environments.

**About Hinge Health**
At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.
  
  
As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com/
  
  
**What You'll Love About Us**

* Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).
* Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.
* Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

**Culture & Engagement**
Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.
